cells.scene: A compact overhead view of an old stone labyrinth with many winding passages, an adult small within one corridor and one clear entrance.
An old damp cupboard opened to reveal dusty books, a few visible mold flecks and stale-air curl marks; no smell-text labels.
A small heap of broken old household objects: cracked teapot, bent lamp, rusty wheel and splintered chair parts.
An artisan uses a small carving tool to cut a simple leaf motif into a wooden block, tiny wood chips nearby.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — labyrinth (n.迷宫): A compact overhead view of an old stone labyrinth with many winding passages, an adult small within one corridor and one clear entrance.
TOP RIGHT — musty (a.陈腐的，发霉的): An old damp cupboard opened to reveal dusty books, a few visible mold flecks and stale-air curl marks; no smell-text labels.
BOTTOM LEFT — junk (n.破烂货，废品): A small heap of broken old household objects: cracked teapot, bent lamp, rusty wheel and splintered chair parts.
BOTTOM RIGHT — carve (v.镌刻): An artisan uses a small carving tool to cut a simple leaf motif into a wooden block, tiny wood chips nearby.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: Checked four curriculum senses, complete silhouettes, natural hand anatomy, and clean white margins along both crop midlines.
